The same stands for Dropbox. If you upload data to the Public folder, you can grab publink, and reimport the data. I haven't tried Sparkleshare and UbuntuOne, but I reckon that they also have some kind of Public folder/link stuff that allows you to grab the data in similar manner. In case you use *NIX system, you can e.g. hook a daemon to watch for changes in Public folder, and attach R script that reimports the file (or whatever) if changes occur. I remember that your beloved R group leader had a question about that one on SO. =)

But of course, Google Docs is not just a file sharing webapp... and in that case, there's no need for daemons and stuff... =)
